0.name: TEXT_REGSEACAMPSKULLVALLEY_00119_AHTMHAS_000_000
0.description: Adventurer! <hex:02080FE905FF064D6127616DFF0453697203>! How might I be of service?

1.name: TEXT_REGSEACAMPSKULLVALLEY_00119_AHTMHAS_000_010
1.description: Me, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6127616DFF0473697203>? I am charged with security of this base, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6127616DFF0473697203>!

2.name: TEXT_REGSEACAMPSKULLVALLEY_00119_AHTMHAS_000_011
2.description: It has been but a year since I took up this post, but I mean to defend Skull Valley with my life, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6127616DFF0473697203>!

3.name: TEXT_REGSEACAMPSKULLVALLEY_00119_AHTMHAS_000_020
3.description: Allow me to explain, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6127616DFF0473697203>! Skull Valley is an encampment established for the purpose of protecting against Sahagin incursions. Though early contact with the fishbacks resulted in only small-scale skirmishes, they have begun moving against us in greater numbers.

4.name: TEXT_REGSEACAMPSKULLVALLEY_00119_AHTMHAS_000_021
4.description: Thus, the facilities here were expanded and reinforced to accommodate a larger Maelstrom presence.

5.name: TEXT_REGSEACAMPSKULLVALLEY_00119_AHTMHAS_000_022
5.description: It would be an honor to have you assist in the many duties that must be performed in order to keep Skull Valley─and perforce, Limsa Lominsa─safe from the Sahagin threat, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6127616DFF0473697203>!

8.name: TEXT_REGSEACAMPSKULLVALLEY_00119_A1_000_002
8.description: What kind of place is this?
